_loader_notes: Stretch routines: single sessions of timed holds (and a few counted moves), stored like routines with type 'stretch' (AGENTS.md S8).
duration_minutes includes about 8 seconds of transition per step. counts_towards_weekly_target is true for sessions of 10 minutes or more (AGENTS.md H1, S5).
Steps use the moves list below, which includes every move from content/warmups-cooldowns plus new ones. Merge them into one moves table by slug.
per_side means both sides; duration is per side.
Recovery days in routines (v2.3, W5) should link to full-body-recovery-flow, happy-hips, back-unwind or after-leg-day.
Draft for coach review before launch. No medical claims: these sessions aim to help her feel looser, not to treat pain.

moves.name: Easy bike
moves.cue: Easy pace, you could chat comfortably.

moves.name: Easy cross-trainer
moves.cue: Easy pace, light resistance.

moves.name: March on the spot
moves.cue: Lift your knees and swing your arms.

moves.name: Cat-cow
moves.cue: On hands and knees, round then gently arch your back with your breath.

moves.name: World's greatest stretch
moves.cue: Step into a lunge, hand inside your front foot, then reach that arm to the ceiling.

moves.name: Bodyweight squat
moves.cue: Sit back and down, then stand tall. Smooth and easy.

moves.name: Glute bridge
moves.cue: Lie on your back, feet flat, lift your hips and squeeze.

moves.name: Leg swings, front to back
moves.cue: Hold something steady and swing one leg gently forwards and back.

moves.name: Leg swings, side to side
moves.cue: Face something steady and swing one leg across your body and out.

moves.name: Reverse lunge
moves.cue: Step back softly, lower your back knee, return.

moves.name: Standing hip circles
moves.cue: Lift one knee and draw a slow circle out to the side.

moves.name: Arm circles
moves.cue: Small circles growing bigger, forwards then backwards.

moves.name: Band pull-apart
moves.cue: Arms straight in front, pull the band apart to your chest.

moves.name: Wall angel
moves.cue: Back against a wall, slide your arms up and down like a snow angel.

moves.name: Open book
moves.cue: Lie on your side, knees bent, and open your top arm across to the other side.

moves.name: Inchworm
moves.cue: Fold forward, walk your hands out to a plank, then walk them back.

moves.name: Scapular push-up
moves.cue: In a plank, let your chest sink between your shoulder blades, then push away.

moves.name: Child's pose
moves.cue: Kneel, sit back on your heels and reach your arms forward. Breathe slowly.

moves.name: Figure four stretch
moves.cue: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the other knee and pull gently towards you.

moves.name: Lying hamstring stretch
moves.cue: Lie on your back and raise one straight leg, holding behind your thigh.

moves.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
moves.cue: Kneel on one knee, tuck your hips under and shift gently forward.

moves.name: Side-lying quad stretch
moves.cue: Lie on your side and pull your top heel towards your bottom.

moves.name: Calf stretch
moves.cue: Hands on a wall, one leg back with the heel down.

moves.name: Chest stretch
moves.cue: Forearm on a wall or upright, turn your body gently away.

moves.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
moves.cue: Pull one arm across your chest with the other.

moves.name: Overhead triceps stretch
moves.cue: Reach one hand down your back and gently press the elbow.

moves.name: Kneeling lat stretch
moves.cue: Kneel, place your hands on a bench and sink your chest down.

moves.name: Seated twist
moves.cue: Sit tall, cross one leg over and turn gently towards the bent knee.

moves.name: Slow breathing
moves.cue: Lie or sit comfortably. Breathe in for 4, out for 6.

moves.name: Neck side stretch
moves.cue: Sit tall and tilt one ear towards your shoulder. Let your other shoulder drop.

moves.name: Chin tuck
moves.cue: Sit tall and gently slide your chin straight back, like making a double chin.

moves.name: Thread the needle
moves.cue: On hands and knees, slide one arm under your body and rest your shoulder down.

moves.name: 90/90 hip switch
moves.cue: Sit with both knees bent at right angles and slowly rotate them side to side.

moves.name: Butterfly stretch
moves.cue: Sit with the soles of your feet together and let your knees relax down.

moves.name: Frog stretch
moves.cue: On all fours, slide your knees wide and gently rock your hips back.

moves.name: Supported deep squat
moves.cue: Hold a rack or bench and sink into a comfortable deep squat.

moves.name: Pigeon stretch
moves.cue: Front shin across the mat, back leg long. Use a rolled towel under your hip if needed.

moves.name: Standing forward fold
moves.cue: Soft knees, let your upper body hang heavy.

moves.name: Lying twist
moves.cue: Lie on your back and let both knees fall to one side.

moves.name: Knees to chest
moves.cue: Lie on your back and hug both knees in. Rock gently if it feels nice.

moves.name: Happy baby
moves.cue: Lie on your back, hold your feet and let your knees drop wide.

moves.name: Sphinx
moves.cue: Lie on your front and prop yourself up on your forearms. Relax your shoulders.

moves.name: Seated forward fold
moves.cue: Sit with legs long and reach towards your feet with a long back.

moves.name: Standing side bend
moves.cue: Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the other side.

moves.name: Legs up the wall
moves.cue: Lie with your legs resting up a wall. Arms relaxed by your sides.

moves.name: Shoulder rolls
moves.cue: Roll your shoulders slowly up, back and down.

moves.name: Wrist and forearm stretch
moves.cue: Arm straight, gently pull your fingers back, then down.

moves.name: Low lunge with reach
moves.cue: From a kneeling lunge, reach the same-side arm up and over.

stretch_routines.name: Morning Mobility
stretch_routines.subtitle: Wake your whole body up
stretch_routines.short_description: A gentle 11-minute flow to loosen everything up first thing. No equipment, just a mat.
who_its_for: You feel stiff in the mornings
You want an easy way to start the day moving
You'd like a stretch habit that takes 10 minutes
stretch_routines.coach_note: Move slowly and breathe through every stretch. You should feel looser at the end, not tired.

stretch_routines.name: After Leg Day
stretch_routines.subtitle: Ease off your legs and glutes
stretch_routines.short_description: The perfect way to finish a lower-body session, or to loosen up the day after.
who_its_for: You've just trained legs or glutes
Your legs feel tight the day after training
You want a calm 10 minutes to finish your session
stretch_routines.coach_note: Hold each stretch somewhere between a gentle pull and comfortable. Never force it.

steps.note: Mat or towel under your knee.

stretch_routines.name: Desk Reset
stretch_routines.subtitle: Six minutes for neck, shoulders and hips
stretch_routines.short_description: Undo a long day of sitting. Most of it can be done standing, so it works anywhere.
who_its_for: You sit at a desk or study for long periods
Your neck and shoulders feel tight
You want something quick you can do anywhere
stretch_routines.coach_note: Small, slow movements work best here. Keep breathing and keep it comfortable.

stretch_routines.name: Happy Hips
stretch_routines.subtitle: A slow session for your hips
stretch_routines.short_description: A slower session all about your hips. Great before a squat day or on a rest day.
who_its_for: Your hips feel tight or stuck
You'd like more comfortable depth in squats
You sit a lot during the day
stretch_routines.coach_note: Hip stretches can feel intense. Ease off if you feel anything sharp, and use a towel for support wherever you like.

steps.note: Figure four on your back works too.
Mat or towel under your knee.

stretch_routines.name: Back Unwind
stretch_routines.subtitle: 10 minutes to loosen your back and spine
stretch_routines.short_description: Gentle movements to help your back feel looser after sitting, standing or training.
who_its_for: Your back feels stiff after a long day
You'd like a gentle, slow session
You want to move your spine in every direction
stretch_routines.coach_note: Keep every movement gentle. If you have back pain, check with your GP or a physiotherapist before doing this session.

stretch_routines.name: Shoulders and Upper Back
stretch_routines.subtitle: Open up after pressing, pulling or a day at a desk
stretch_routines.short_description: Release your chest, shoulders and upper back. A natural partner to any upper-body day.
who_its_for: You've just trained upper body
You'd like to sit and stand a little taller
Your shoulders feel rounded or tight
stretch_routines.coach_note: Let your breathing do the work. Each breath out, sink a little further into the stretch.

stretch_routines.name: Full-Body Recovery Flow
stretch_routines.subtitle: 20 minutes for rest and recovery days
stretch_routines.short_description: A longer, slower session for recovery days. Every major area, with time to breathe.
who_its_for: You're on a recovery day in your routine
You want something gentle that still counts
You'd like a calm 20 minutes
stretch_routines.coach_note: There's no rush today. Take extra breaths in any stretch that feels good.

stretch_routines.name: Wind Down
stretch_routines.subtitle: A calm way to end the day
stretch_routines.short_description: Slow, floor-based stretches and breathing. A calm way to finish your day.
who_its_for: You like to switch off in the evening
You prefer slow, relaxing sessions
You want stretches you can do lying down
stretch_routines.coach_note: Dim the lights if you can. Breathe out for longer than you breathe in.

steps.note: A wall in the stretching area works perfectly.
